english.app[content][earlyaccess][why]: EXODUSER: HELL LORD is an action RPG in which combat controls, bullet parrying, chain traversal, skill combinations and equipment builds are closely connected. english.app[content][earlyaccess][how_long]: We plan to remain in Early Access until the game's core content and systems are sufficiently complete and combat balance and stability are ready for a full release. The duration may vary depending on development progress and player feedback.
english.app[content][earlyaccess][full_version]: For the full version, we plan to add more areas, stages, bosses, enemies, skills and equipment options, and expand the existing systems. english.app[content][earlyaccess][pricing]: We plan to determine pricing during Early Access based on development progress and the scale of added content. The price may change at full release, and we will announce any decisions in advance.
english.app[content][earlyaccess][community]: We plan to gather feedback through the Steam Community and from players on combat balance, difficulty, skill and equipment builds, boss patterns, performance and usability. english.app[content][about]: [p]EXODUSER: HELL LORD is a dark fantasy hack-and-slash ARPG about climbing out of the seven layers of hell.[/p][p]The moment a brutal revenge ended in its final execution, a blade pierced him from behind. He woke at the bottom of hell. He does not remember how he fell, but one thing is certain: his children are alive above the surface, waiting. Seven layers of damnation and thirty-five stages stand between him and them.[/p][p]The goddess of vengeance Nemesia walks at his side, claiming to guide him. Whether her help is real or another trap, no one can say. Pick up your blade and survive for now. Survive long enough, and even hell ends somewhere.[/p][p]Wield a colossal greatsword to carve through hundreds of demons in real time. Master Bullet Language, a color-keyed parry system that turns enemy projectiles back into weapons. Use Chain Drive grappling to close gaps or escape danger. A black cat named Diroy, a raven called Hector, and a ghost-bound crossbow accompany the climb.[/p][p]KEY FEATURES[/p][p]Real-time mass combat. No attack-ticket systems or artificial slowdowns.[/p][p]Bullet Language. A color-keyed parry system for deflecting deadly bullet patterns.[/p][p]Chain Drive. Hold-charge chain mobility for closing or breaking distance.[/p][p]Seven chapters, thirty-five-plus stages, thirty-five-plus bosses. Each carries their own tragedy.[/p][p]Skill fusion. Six archetypes, five rarity tiers, and over twenty-one fusion combinations.[/p][p]Live service. The door to player feedback stays open, and the fusion and build space keep growing.[/p][p]A love letter to dark fantasy, hand-crafted by a solo developer at FDG (FOR DEAR GAMERS).[/p]
english.app[content][short_description]: Fight through hordes of demons in a dark fantasy action RPG. Parry color-coded bullet patterns, chain across the battlefield, fuse skills into devastating attacks, and build your own loadout as you climb through seven layers of hell.

Verbeter en versmelt vaardigheden voor je eigen build in deze darkfantasy-hack-and-slash-actie-RPG.[/p][h2]Over dit spel[/h2][p][b]EXODUSER: HELL LORD[/b] is een darkfantasy-hack-and-slash-actie-RPG voor één speler, waarin je vanuit de diepste hel omhoog probeert te ontsnappen naar de oppervlakte.[/p][p]Veeg aanstormende demonen weg met een grootzwaard en uiteenlopende vaardigheden. [p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/library_hero_3840x1240"][/img]Kort beskrivelse[/p][p]Hugg ned hundrevis av demoner, parer prosjektilsalver med tasten som passer fargen, og fest kjettingen i vegger for å krysse slagmarken.
